mapper.select: SELECT id,phone,nickname,status FROM user_account WHERE id=#{userId}
SELECT id,user_id,name,pet_type,breed_name,birth_date,sex,weight_kg, sterilization_status,vaccine_status,health_note,avatar_url,is_default,status FROM user_pet WHERE id=#{petId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,user_id,name,pet_type,breed_name,birth_date,sex,weight_kg, sterilization_status,vaccine_status,health_note,avatar_url,is_default,status FROM user_pet WHERE user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_pet SET name=#{name},breed_name=#{breedName},birth_date=#{birthDate},sex=#{sex},weight_kg=#{weightKg}, sterilization_status=#{sterilizationStatus},vaccine_status=#{vaccineStatus},health_note=#{healthNote},avatar_url=#{avatarUrl},is_default=#{isDefault}, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE user_pet SET status='DISABLED',is_default=0,version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{petId} AND user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE user_pet SET is_default=0,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND is_default=1 AND id<>#{keepPetId}
